title: Repair, Retry, and the Cost of Hindsight: Verifier Feedback in Formal Theorem Proving
abstract: arXiv:2610.22698v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Verifier-guided self-repair conditions a model on feedback from failed attempts before it tries again, without weight updates. Yet two findings in prior work are in tension: verifier feedback can improve repair of failures, but self-repair itself can provide little-to-no advantage over independent resampling. We reconcile these findings in Lean theorem proving through controlled one-step experiments that hold the preceding failure fixed while varying whether the failed proof is shown, whether the compiler error corresponds to that failure, and the retry instruction. We test frozen Qwen3.6-27B, a general-purpose model, and DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B, a specialized prover, on difficult MiniF2F problems. We find two opposing effects. Showing the model its failed predecessor reduces success and sharply increases copying of it, while on Qwen adding that attempt's compiler error recovers the loss, to the level of the diagnostic alone. translated_title: 修复、重试与后见之明的代价：形式化定理证明中的验证器反馈
translated_abstract: 验证器引导的自我修复是指模型在再次尝试之前，将失败尝试的反馈作为条件输入，而无需更新模型权重。然而，先前工作中的两个发现之间存在矛盾：验证器反馈可以改进对失败的修复，但自我修复本身相比独立重采样几乎没有优势。我们通过受控的单步实验在Lean定理证明中调和了这些发现，实验在固定前一次失败的前提下，改变是否展示失败的证明、编译器错误是否与该失败相对应、以及重试指令。我们在困难的MiniF2F问题上测试了冻结的Qwen3.6-27B（通用模型）和DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B（专用证明器）。我们发现了两种相反的效应：向模型展示其失败的前一次尝试会降低成功率并大幅增加对该尝试的复制，而在Qwen上，加入该次尝试的编译器错误可以挽回这一损失，恢复到仅使用诊断信息的水平。替换……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文通过受控单步实验调和了先前研究中的矛盾发现，表明在Lean定理证明中，展示失败的证明会损害重试效果并加剧复制行为，而附加对应的编译器错误信息则可以挽回这一损失。
en_tdlr: This paper reconciles conflicting prior findings through controlled one-step experiments in Lean theorem proving, showing that showing the failed proof harms retry success and increases copying, while adding the corresponding compiler error recovers the loss.
